note: mapping_basis=data_labels. DERIVATION: the .do reads DA2986 with an infix identical to ES2986's DATA LIST (P19 col 109, P2101..P2110 cols 112..121), 'rename *, lower', and Bookmark 8 loops gen item = the literal names p19 p2101..p2110 -- the item code IS the CIS variable name lowercased (core model s3 pattern 1). REBUILD, decisive: re-running the .do logic on DA2986 (2484 lines; id = row number; only P19 codes 8/9 set missing, .do line 291; P2101..P2110 get NO recode; cov_sex = P30, cov_age = P31 with 99 -> NA) reproduces the live table exactly: 27324 rows both, 2484 ids, id-item-resp sets identical (0/0 set differences, 0 duplicate id-item keys), resp/cov_sex/cov_age 0 mismatches, against the local irw cache copy written by table_context.R (no additional export). Live item x resp (0/1/2/NA): p19 863/1134/478/9; p2101 1350/370/-/764; p2102 1350/218/-/916; p2103 1350/354/-/780; p2104 1350/61/-/1073; p2105 1350/239/-/895; p2106 1350/161/-/973; p2107 1350/101/-/1033; p2108 1350/12/-/1122; p2109 1350/5/-/1129; p2110 1350/7/-/1127. DATA DEFECT 1 (p19, the known batch_365 pattern): resp 0 is CIS code 0 'No procede', declared MISSING in ES2986 ('MISSING VALUES ... P19 (0)'); the .do recodes only 8/9, so 0 survives. P18 x P19 cross-tab: P19=0 for exactly the 862 P18=2 (did not use the Internet in 12 months) + 1 P18=9 respondents, 0 off-diagonal; the questionnaire routes P.18 'No'/'N.C.' through P.18a/P.18b to 'PASAR A P.25'. So 863/2484 p19 rows are not-asked. p19 also keeps 9 NA rows (P19=8 No recuerda 5, =9 N.C. 4). DATA DEFECT 2 (p2101..p2110, worse): P.21 is a multiple-response question ('RESPUESTA MÚTIPLE [sic]. MARCAR TODAS LAS QUE DIGA LA PERSONA ENTREVISTADA') asked only of P19=1 ('HACER PREGUNTAS 20 a 24 A QUIENES HAN CONTESTADO "SÍ" EN P.19'). In DA2986 each dummy is '0' for the 1350 respondents with P19 != 1 (863 P19=0 + 478 P19=2 + 5 P19=8 + 4 P19=9; 0 exceptions) and, for the 1134 P19=1 respondents, '1' when the purpose was mentioned and BLANK when it was not (e.g. P2101 370 '1' / 764 blank; every P19=1 respondent has at least one mention across P2101-P2117, 0 all-blank, consistent with blank = not mentioned). Stata infix reads blank as missing and the .do does no recode, so in the live table resp 0 = not asked (label 'No procede', not in ES2986's MISSING VALUES list for these variables), resp 1 = mentioned, and the real negative answer (asked, did not mention) is NA and carries no option row. The 0-vs-1 contrast is therefore asked-vs-not-asked confounded with the answer, not No vs Yes. Suggested data fix in Bookmark 8: set p19 0 -> missing (add 0 to the inlist); for p2101..p2110, among p19==1 recode missing -> 0 (not mentioned) and set 0 -> missing where p19 != 1.
